for the people, not the parties!


Ro Khanna (@RoKhanna)

.@RepThomasMassie & I achieved the two most consequential victories of Trump's 2nd term.

The Epstein Transparency Act exposed the cover up for sexual abuse.

Our Iran WPR, introduced months ago, led to passage last night.

Bipartisanship for the people, not the establishment.



— https://nitter.net/RoKhanna/status/2062510853656580363#m

Thank you @RepTomBarrett for respecting the Constitution.


Congressman Tom Barrett (@RepTomBarrett)

Congress has the exclusive authority under the Constitution to declare war and authorize the use of force. The War Powers Act of 1973 delegates some of that authority to the president for a limited period of time.

That authority has expired, and my support of this resolution tonight is consistent with my belief that it is time for Congress to decide the scope of the mission and the appropriate

G’day mate, where’s the party headed?

Video

The Iran War Powers Resolution that I cosponsored (opposing the war) just passed the House of Representatives.

The People’s House is sending a message: end this war.

Full bill text:

congress.gov/119/bills/hr356…

Cosponsors:

congress.gov/bill/119th-cong…

Israel has used American-supplied munitions to kill tens of thousands of innocent civilians.

America is morally obligated to end support of Israel’s devastation of Gaza and its people. I’m cosponsoring the Block the Bombs Act to limit the transfer of offensive weapons to Israel.

No one should have to beg the government to exercise a constitutionally protected right anywhere in the country. 

Thank you @RepShreve for cosponsoring HR 645, the National Constitutional Carry Act.
